messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staging deploy (soft-latch).
deploy-bot: env=staging  tag=`v2.4.0-canary.202`  commit=`b7e2f1a`  mode=`soft-latch` (5% traffic). change-window=2025-07-15 01:00-01:30 UTC. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/release/v2.4.0
maria: ack — watching canaries, I'll run the quick smoke checklist.
kevin: noting the commit, leaving a pin on prior stable for fast rollback if needed: `v2.3.9` pinned.
rachel: @maria thanks — can you run the reranker sanity and latency smoke in us-west-2 first?
maria: running checks now: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api/redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq '.latency'
ab -n 100 -c 5 https://staging.api/health
```
kevin: @deploy-bot what's the canary bucket id? want to tail logs.
deploy-bot: canary_bucket=cb-43, streaming logs via `staging-ci tail cb-43` — granted to @maria @kevin @rachel.
maria: quick smoke: reranker accuracy OK, but seeing a small latency bump (~40ms) in us-west-2 compared to baseline (~18ms). digging into p95.
oncall: tagging @oncall — if p95 stays > 120ms we should hold and fallback.
kevin: I'll start a lightweight profiling trace, but meanwhile can we prepare a fallback to quantized model? `model=redwood-reranker-q4` ready.
rachel: agree — if latency doesn't drop in 3 mins, switch traffic to fallback for the canary.
maria: p95 is down to ~22ms after one warmup — looks transient. continuing 10m watch.
staging-ci: canary smoke checks passed: health=OK, errors=0/100, latency delta +4ms. auto-progressing per soft-latch policy.
kevin: rolling from 5% -> 20% per policy. monitoring.
maria: no new anomalies in logs, reranker metrics stable.
rachel: +1 to proceed. leaving rollout open for 10m, then full traffic if stable.
oncall: +1 — keep alerting on p95 spikes.
staging-ci: rollout complete to 100% in staging. final commit=`b7e2f1a` tag=`v2.4.0-canary.202`.
deploy-bot: STAGING DEPLOY COMPLETE :tada: — uptime check ok, smoke passed, runbook step 7 complete. Release notes draft: https://notes.internal/redwood/v2.4.0
kevin: moving pin off `v2.3.9` now that canary stable. leave a traffic-safety flag for production cutoff.
maria: thanks team — will file a short postmortem if anything pops. :thumbsup:
rachel: closing thread, will start PR for release notes and schedule prod change-window tomorrow.
